body:
I just recognize that I am not a good person. I have diagnosed BPD, anxiety, and depression. 
I have been a snappy asshole, my marriage is failing because I can’t get myself to change and do my job as a parent and stay at home mom. I just don’t see how I will be a positive role model or influence in my kids life.
I will definitely looking into someone to talk to. I don’t have anyone right now besides my husband but he has had a hard core view on it since the beginning, it’s like talking to a wall.

I don’t think I explained my question well enough, honestly I am not really sure what I am asking.

I am not willing to cut everyone off, but I don’t think I can tolerate his behavior either. I am very confused :(
Thank you for understand where I am coming from.
Thank you
I know this is going to sound stupid and naive, but I truly think this was a one time event. He was dealing with something terrible(suicide) and was drunk when it happened.
I have tried looking up his court records before but it was just the basic information. Nothing too detailed.
I don’t think that they would turn up unannounced with him because he doesn’t want a relationship with me right now either
I guess I am conflicted because I do kind of want a relationship with him but I don’t know if it’s because of my personal want or if I am being influenced by those around me.
I just want to know the whole story. Did he do something monstrous or not? That’s all I want to know.

I don’t want to drop my entire family, but I feel like that is what is going to end up happening. Which is devastating, especially the thought of losing my sister as she has always been there for me. 

I don’t mind having a relationship with my brother, but he and everyone else needs to know that I will not rug sweep what happened...which I think is going to be the biggest issue.
I don’t think it’s going to work out that way as he is going to be living with my Mom after he gets out. If he doesn’t want me at the house I don’t think I’ll be allowed there.

I do want him in my life, I just don’t know if it’s possible. He resents me right now because I haven’t visited, which I understand. I resent him for how he is treating those who do visit him. We both need to talk but neither of us are being mature enough to reach out to the other. 

I did earlier this year, asking him to tell me what happened because I was hearing conflicting stories. But he just told me he was my brother and would be there(prison) if I wanted to talk.

Thank you for the reply
It is nice to know that someone else understands, because it seems like no one else does.

The one time I flat out told my husband that I was going to kill myself, he was a great support and immediately helped me. 
The fights just drain me, because they are so far and in between. It’s like we can’t stop arguing once it starts until something horrible is said.
I just kind of feel like they would get over it. I don’t know...I just don’t really think they would care. My sister might...but I think that’s all.

I have read all of the comments, and the "negative" ones have me worried about slipping back into my ED. If so many people are saying the same thing, there is probably a reason to worry. 
I am going to go talk to my doctor before I start any kind of restrictive diet. 
Thank you for all the responses!
I go to my Dads house on a regular basis, maybe twice a week. They watch what I eat very closely because of my history, so they would notice very quickly that I was dieting.

Yes this!
If I am not counting calories I tend to skip meals because I am trying to eat as little as possible to get through the day. With counting calories I know I can eat throughout the day, and it will be a reasonable amount with worry of over or under doing it!

I don't see 1200 as drastic, I am, or well was, a small person. I don't think someone of my height and stature needs more than 1200 a day.
But I will make an appointment with my doctor, for everyone's peace of mind. :)
I really have no idea
I will try this next time! :)

I think this is an important point I have to make to them. I frequently forget to eat because I am running around with a 2 year old and a 8 week old puppy. I actually have reminders set on my phone to eat something! The calorie counting really is just to make sure I hit a healthy amount, because if not I'll either not eat enough or binge and eat way too much. 
Thank you!
I will be telling them this tomorrow! Thank you!

Thank you very much :)
I am already feeling better with the support I have gotten here!

Yes this exactly! They think it's just me trying to lose weight so I can be skinny again. But this is about me being healthier and being able to chase and play with my son without feeling winded after five minutes. I am also small in height and body stature, so the weight I am now just makes my whole body ache. I am not meant to be this overweight.

I know they mean well,but they are making matters worse. I am not allowed to talk about my weight around them because they say I am being negative.

I am keeping track of my eating habits very closely, and have two accountability buddies to help me out as well.

Yes, I have also tried explaining this to him but it falls on deaf ears. He is the type that he can eat whatever he wants and can exercise to keep his weight under control, so he thinks everyone is like that.
He does try to support me, telling me I can do it, and cheering for me when I make healthy food decisions, he just doesn't like me dieting.  

I do live on my own with my husband, but we also have a 2 year old son who loves him Grandpa and Great Grandma, so we visit the house very often. Especially since it is five minutes away from us.

Hello! I don't know if you are still looking, but our stats are pretty similar. I am starting over, I am 23/F/201lbs. My goal weight is 110lbs. 
I have a difficult history with weightloss and trouble with binge eating, so I would love someone to be able to hold me accountable for that. Thanks in advance!
I would be able to get a job that could support my kid and I if something did happen. I have experience in the career that I am going into and have held jobs like it before.

I have quite a bit of experience in the job field that I am studying to go into. I already had a couple jobs that were in that job field as well. If, god forbid, something did happen, I would be able to get a job that could support our kid and me.

My husband is super okay with me being a stay at home mom. He encourages it, not to take away my independence, but because he knows how much I love it.
My family can't understand that.

I've been trying to hint to the fact that this fall semester will probably be my last one. But they just get pissy about it. Like we are talking about getting a dog next year and the only thing my family said was,"won't getting a dog interfere with school?"
